name: ZCA_ROLLUP_CALCULATION
description: This is a temporary dynamic table that stores the calculated rollup values for each source object record that needs to be updated to source object rollup table.

columns.name: OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: Name of the source object. This is a foreign key to LANG_INDEPENDENT_CODE column in ZCA_OBJECTS table.

columns.name: OBJECT_PK
columns.description: Primary key attribute value of the source object row.

columns.name: ROLLUP_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier for the rollup. Copied from ZCA_ROLLUPS_B table.
